{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Doc changes in doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md and release notes follow the RPC implementation rather than documentation being the primary change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follow-up documentation changes for a code feature do not make the PR a member of docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/netbase.cpp and src/netbase.h update low-level socket abstractions to support local UNIX sockets, not node-to-node P2P transport, peer selection, or relay.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR affects local RPC server transport and proxy abstractions rather than P2P message protocol or peer networking."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies src/httpserver.cpp, src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, and RPC configuration handling.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Closes a decade-old feature request (#5029) to support UNIX domain sockets for the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli. This provides substantial user value by allowing filesystem permissions instead of IP allowlists and eliminating TCP loopback overhead."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications to test framework files (test_node.py, authproxy.py) merely support test coverage for the RPC UNIX socket feature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to test utilities that follow directly from testing an RPC feature belong to RPC, not general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/init.cpp and netbase primitives exist to serve RPC and proxy configuration rather than general node-wide utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Settings and socket changes whose point is another specific area's behavior belong to that area."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
